Name: Animals to Pokemon
Author: TinyKawaiiSatan
Description:
INCLUDES:
 White Cows --> Miltank
 Baby Sheep --> Mareep
Sheep --> Flaafy

PLEASE NOTE:
I have not added in baby white cows, or sheared sheep. These will be added in later, so hit Track to be notified when I update!

HOW TO INSTALL:
-- Unzip the files
-- Place the .xnb files into  the Animals folder in your Stardew Valley "Content" folder 

REQUIRES:
--SMAPI

RECOMMENDED:
--I suggest you use this mod with LittleNerdyOTAKU's Pokemon mod. https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/327
--And for extra by CharlesLing: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1264

CREDITS:
  The current sprites were found here: https://www.spriters-resource.com/game_boy_advance/pokemonmysterydungeonredrescueteam/


COMING SOON:
 Brown Chickens to Torchics
 Blue Chickens to Piplups
 Goats to Skiddos and Gogoats
 Sheared Sheep to Sheared Flaafy
 Seagulls to Wingulls
